label.purpose: Connection state, revision details, and trust copy.

code.purpose: Prompts, editable source, output, and tracebacks.

motion.name: reduced-motion-floor
motion.purpose: Collapses any incidental animation when reduced motion is requested; the interface otherwise avoids decorative motion.

components.name: Shell Header
components.description: Compact product identity and connection status above the notebook canvas.
components.css: .ds-shell-header { min-height: 48px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 0 20px; color: #263238; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7dcdf; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-shell-header div { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; } .ds-shell-header strong { color: #d66b2c; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-shell-header span, .ds-shell-header output { color: #53636b; font-size: 0.82rem; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-shell-header { padding: 0 12px; } .ds-shell-header span { display: none; } }

components.name: Browser Button
components.description: Square fallback and recovery action with visible focus.
components.css: .ds-button { border: 1px solid #84949c; background: #fff; padding: 7px 12px; color: #263238; cursor: pointer; font: 400 16px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 0; } .ds-button:hover { background: #eef4f7; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d698f; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button:active { background: #dfeaf0; }

components.name: Selected Notebook Cell
components.description: Active cell with a compact drag target and execution prompt; structural notebook actions live in the stable toolbar and menus. Cells with microscopes use a drawn microscope dropdown icon with the accessible name Microscopes (N).
components.html:

value = 40 + 2
components.css: .ds-cell { color-scheme: light; padding: 10px; color: #263238; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #d2d2d2; border-radius: 3px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-cell-selected { background: #fafdff; border: 2px solid #2d6991; } .ds-cell-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-cell-action-group { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-cell-actions > i { width: 1px; height: 22px; background: #d2d2d2; } .ds-cell code, .ds-cell pre { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-cell button { min-height: clamp(25.5px, 3.75vw, 30px); border: 0; background: #e6e6e6; color: #4b555c; padding: 5px 8px; } .ds-cell button:hover { background: #dce6eb; } .ds-cell button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d698f; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-cell button:active { background: #cfdde4; } .ds-cell pre { margin: 10px 0 0; padding: 8px 4px; background: #fff; }

components.name: Notebook Output
components.description: Committed text, stream, rich-data summary, or traceback directly beneath its source.
components.css: .ds-output { margin: 8px 0 0; padding: 8px; color: #263238; background: #f8fafb; border-radius: 0; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font: 400 14px/20px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-output:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d698f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Kernel Status Strip
components.description: Persistent synchronization, kernel, and revision context at the canvas edge, preceded by the explorer toggle at the bottom-left.
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 32px; color: #53636b; background: #f7f7f7; border-top: 1px solid #c4c4c4; font: 400 13px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status span { padding: 6px 10px; border-right: 1px solid #d7dcdf; } .ds-status i { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-right: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2e7d32; } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d698f; outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Action Required Status
components.description: Bounded failure state that pairs the error with the next valid recovery action.
components.html: Action requiredConnection lost — Retry or reconnect.
components.css: .ds-status-error { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 10px; color: #b71c1c; background: #fff; border-top: 1px solid #d7dcdf; font: 400 13px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-error strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-status-error i { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-right: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #c62828; } .ds-status-error:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d698f; outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Fatal Error Panel
components.description: Startup failure replacement with a specific message and direct retry action.
components.html:
The notebook could not start

The local notebook service did not respond.
components.css: .ds-fatal { max-width: 640px; margin: 80px auto; padding: 28px; color: #263238; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #c3cbd0; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-fatal h1 { margin-top: 0; font-size: 1.4rem; } .ds-fatal button { border: 1px solid #84949c; background: #fff; padding: 7px 12px; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-fatal button:hover { background: #eef4f7; } .ds-fatal button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d698f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Trust Notice
components.description: Persistent local-execution warning beneath the notebook.
components.html: Local execution is unsafe. Only run notebooks you trust.
components.css: .ds-trust-note { margin: 0; padding: 8px 20px; color: #53636b; background: #fff8e8; border-top: 1px solid #ead49e; font: 400 0.82rem/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-trust-note:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d698f; outline-offset: -3px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-trust-note { padding-inline: 12px; } }

components.name: Notebook Explorer
components.description: Confined notebook workspace with folder navigation, current-notebook selection, and independent scrolling. Notebook rows show muted right-aligned microscope totals; recognized owned sidecars are hidden while orphans remain visible. Export workspace sits below create/upload controls and downloads a bounded ZIP of saved content, excluding temporary kernel state.

components.css: .ds-explorer { width: 248px; max-width: 100%; padding: 12px; overflow-y: auto; color: #263238; background: #fff; border-right: 1px solid #d7dcdf; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-explorer h2 { font-size: 1rem; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-explorer p { color: #53636b; font-size: .82rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-folder-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-explorer button { border: 1px solid #84949c; border-radius: 0; padding: 7px 12px; background: #fff; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-explorer button:hover { background: #eef4f7; } .ds-explorer button:active { background: #dfeaf0; } .ds-explorer button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d698f; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-explorer button:disabled { cursor: default; color: #53636b; background: #f7f7f7; } .ds-explorer .ds-file { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 4px; border: 0; text-align: left; font-size: .82rem; } .ds-file span { overflow-wrap: anywhere; min-width: 0; } .ds-file svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-explorer [aria-current] { background: #d2e8f6; color: #194e70; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-explorer { width: 180px; } }

narrative.overview:
didaction should feel like opening the original Jupyter Notebook on a trusted local machine: a quiet vertical document, compact IDE chrome, and controls that stay close to the work. Familiarity is functional here. It lets a person read cells, edit code, execute, inspect output, recover the kernel, and resume without first learning a new interface language.

The visual system is deliberately utilitarian rather than expressive. White working surfaces sit on a nearly white canvas; thin dividers organize the shell; selection, focus, and kernel state receive the strongest color. The egui canvas explicitly uses light visuals so system preference cannot change this material grammar. The small orange wordmark is the only persistent brand accent. There are no decorative illustrations, floating panels, gradients, or ornamental motion.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, desktop-IDE chrome that wraps cleanly on narrow screens.
Explicit light-mode egui primitives with Jupyter-familiar menus, toolbar icons, cell-type control, and execution prompts.
Flat light surfaces separated by thin rules rather than depth effects.
Restrained sans-serif interface type paired with monospace code and output.
Blue emphasis for focus and cell selection; semantic color only for status and risk.
Quiet state changes with visible, actionable recovery paths.

rules.name: The Color Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Outside the wordmark, color must indicate focus, selection, synchronization, execution, warning, or failure.

rules.name: The Current Cell Rule
rules.body: The selected cell uses both a stronger blue edge and a barely tinted surface, so selection remains clear without filling the document with color.

rules.name: The Code Stays Code Rule
rules.body: Prompts, editable source, execution results, and tracebacks always use monospace; surrounding controls and system status always use the UI sans.

rules.name: The Document Owns the Viewport Rule
rules.body: Chrome stays compact so working cells, output, and kernel state remain visible together whenever the viewport allows it.

rules.name: The Narrow Screen Preserves the Task Rule
rules.body: Controls may wrap and secondary labels may disappear, but execution, recovery, status, and the ordered cell document remain available.

rules.name: The Flat Notebook Rule
rules.body: Do not use shadows, glass, gradients, or floating cards to separate ordinary notebook regions; use tonal surfaces and one-pixel rules.

rules.name: The Almost-Square Rule
rules.body: Corners should feel structural and tool-like. Do not introduce pill controls or large card radii.

dos: Do keep the vertical notebook document, its ordered cells, and each output directly adjacent to its source.
Do reserve blue for focus, selection, and running state; reserve green, orange, and red for explicit system meaning.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and touch-sized controls at narrow widths.
Do keep selected-cell primitives in the stable Jupyter toolbar order, with descriptive hover text and equivalent menu labels.
Do keep failures bounded, specific, and paired with the next valid recovery action.
Do show synchronization, kernel state, and revision as quiet persistent metadata.
donts: Don't turn cells into elevated cards or distribute them across a dashboard grid.
Don't add decorative motion, gradients, glass effects, or oversized brand moments.
Don't hide interrupt, restart, reconnect, or failure guidance behind icon-only controls.
Don't use proportional type for code, prompts, output, or tracebacks.
Don't let responsive wrapping reorder the execution story or separate output from its cell.
